limits: Reference assets and future-stage bitmaps are evaluation data, never simulation inputs.
P1 route variants are reverse-engineer reports, not independently certified hardware traces; P2 pictured routes remain incomplete.
Unknown image targets must remain unavailable and cannot pass visual similarity gates.
A single selected pose does not establish animation, timing, care-rule or whole-lifecycle fidelity.
Regional variants Oyajitchi, Nyatchi and Sekitoritchi are excluded from the English baseline.
